data.detailed_description:
This purchase also unlocks characters and scenes inside SinVR 2: Forbidden World

A sinfully wild Sci-Fi Adventure, with a Happy Ending! Lose yourself in the impressively graphic, stimulated 3D, visually novelistic world of Space SEX.

Sex in Space never felt so good!
Choose your female companions and take them on a journey through time and space.

Spacey Features:
  • 5 stories in visual novel format and interactive sex.
  • Threesomes!
  • Super deep, immersively wet storytelling.
  • An interactive PC experience unlike any other!
  • Custom combinations of sexual partners
  • Supports No-VR mode, with only a PC & mouse (no VR headset)
  • VR support for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift with Touch
  • Did I mention threesomes?

Bonus:
  • All characters and scenes are also unlocked for free inside SinVR 2: Forbidden World!
  • 'Mix and Match' to your heart's content!

[b]Space SEX[/b] is a lewd set of short stories with interactive sex scenes.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
You pick a story. Read through a series of comicbook-styled stills, watch a sex scene, and then read some more.

[h1]Story[/h1]
As this game is a series of short stories, I'll provide a synopsis for each one that is currently available; In "A New Companion", Michael orders a non-so-virtual [i]ass[/i]istant; In "Foreman's Foreplay", a ladyfriend rewards Michael for helping her beat a level in her game; In "Streaming Secrets", Michael stumbles upon a sexually charged dynamic duo; In "Forbidden Pleasure", Michael's living quarters loses power, and he winds up in the bar in search of a [i]quickie[/i]; finally, in "Punishment Served", Michael finds himself under arrest, but his officer is bored and horny.

[h1]Visuals[/h1]
The game boots into the "Choose a Story" screen, where you can pick a (previously unlocked) tale to read. The interface looks darned good — it's [i]very[/i] aesthetically pleasing, and meshes well with the overall sci-fi theme. From "Settings", you can adjust graphical and resolution preferences. It's unclear how the "Graphics Quality" slider affects the in-game visuals, and I would have liked to have been able to adjust individual graphical settings (such as anti-aliasing or depth of field). There is also no audio preferences, which is kind of BS.

Oh and there's a ton of clipping!

[b]- The Goods -[/b]
I had mixed feelings about the goodies. The models look alright, but they often appear fuzzy or lifeless. The sex scenes sport a solid roster of positions to put each actor in. However, there is no interactivity beyond telling everyone where to go. Expect female nudity and male-on-female sexual intercourse.

[h1]Verdict[/h1]
I hate to say it, but [i]wait for a sale.[/i] I really like the idea behind this game — a collection of one-off stories followed with senseless bangin'? You can count me in. But given the playtime and rough edges, I would suggest waiting for a light sale, or a few solid updates.
